What to know about the last week of birth control pills

Medically reviewed by Stacy A. Henigsman, DO — Written by Nicole Galan, RN — Updated on March 31, 2025
  • What are placebo pills?
  • Do I have to take them?
  • Can you skip the break?
  • Not getting a period
  • Summary

In some types of birth control pills, the last week of the pack usually consists of inactive or placebo pills. These pills do not contain any hormones.

There are many different types of birth control pills. One of the most common is the combination pill, which contains synthetic forms of the hormones estrogen and progesterone.

Many brands of the combined pill include this week of inactive pills to induce a bleed that mimics a period. Taking them ensures people maintain the regular habit of taking the pill without accidentally skipping days.

However, the exact amount of placebo pills in each pack may vary depending on the brand.

Read on to learn more about placebo pills, whether it is necessary to take them, and more.

What are placebo pills?

Share on PinterestOlena Malik/Getty Images

The placebo pills in birth control pill packets are inactive and do not contain any hormones. The purpose of them is to give people a regular “break” from the hormones and induce a bleed, which mimics a monthly period.

However, there is no medical need for this break, and not all brands of birth control pills include them. Other brands only have a small number of them.

People usually get a bleed while taking the placebo pills because the body reacts to the drop in hormone levels by shedding the uterine lining.

Common types of combination pill packs include:

  • 28-day pill packs: These packs involve taking 1 pill per day and starting a new pack on day 29. Many have 3 weeks of active pills and 1 week of placebo pills, but some contain less.
  • 21-day pill packs: These pill packs contain 21 days of pills with active hormones. A person will then go 7 days without any pills and then start a new pack.
  • 91-day pill packs: Some types of pills have 12 weeks of active pills and up to 1 week of inactive pills. People taking these pills should only get their period once every 3 months.

Placebo pills usually consist of sugar, but some may have other ingredients, such as iron or vitamins.

Do you have to take the placebo pills?

No, people do not have to take the placebo pills in their birth control packet. They can skip the placebo pills for 7 days and then begin another pack if they wish.

However, individuals who do not take the placebo pills during the break must remember to resume the next pack on time so they do not have a risk of an unplanned pregnancy.

With typical use, combined birth control pills are 91% effective at preventing pregnancy, regardless of whether or not people take the placebo pills. With perfect use, they are 99% effective.

However, if someone is unsure they will remember to resume the pills at the right time, it may be better to continue taking 1 pill per day, including the placebo pills. This helps maintain a routine.

Can you skip the placebo pills?

Possibly, but it depends on the type of birth control pill.

Some brands of the pill provide a steady dose of hormones throughout the month. In these cases, people can skip the placebo week and go straight into a new pack of active pills.

Doing this means individuals can delay or skip their monthly bleed, which may be convenient if they have a significant event coming up. There is no harm in doing this.

An article by the American College of Gynecologists (ACOG) says that there is no correct number of periods a person must have while taking birth control pills. Some people take the active pills continuously so that they never have one.

However, some varieties of birth control pills do not allow back-to-back dosing, as the dosing varies by week within the pack. Therefore, people need to ensure that the pill they are taking is suitable to use on an extended cycle.

It is also important to know which pills are placebo and which are active to reduce the risk of an unplanned pregnancy.

Anyone who is unsure which pills are active and which are inactive needs to consult a doctor or pharmacist to ensure they know how to do this correctly.

A doctor can also provide guidance regarding the safety of skipping the placebo pills.

Not getting a period on placebo pills

Many people find that they do not bleed or that they experience lighter bleeding while taking birth control pills.

This may be due to a few vital functions of the pill, which works by:

  • stopping ovulation
  • thickening cervical mucus to block sperm
  • keeping the lining of the uterus thin to prevent implantation

When the uterine lining is thin, there will be less blood and tissue to shed during the hormone-free period. For some, this may mean no bleed at all. This can be natural and does not signify anything is wrong.

However, if a person has concerns they may be pregnant, they can take a home pregnancy test to be sure.

If an individual would rather get a period regularly for peace of mind, they may wish to discuss a different type of contraception with their doctor.

Summary

In many packs of combination birth control pills, there are placebo pills that do not contain active hormones. Taking them creates a break in the dose of hormones, inducing a bleed that mimics a period.

This break is not medically necessary, so some people choose to occasionally skip the placebo week and go into a new pack of active pills. Others run their active pills together so that they never have a break.

However, people need to check with a doctor or pharmacist before doing this, as not all types of birth control pills have consistent doses in them. It is also essential to be clear on which pills in the packet are inactive.

48 Hour Surface Forecast United States Four Corners Great Lakes Great Plains Gulf Coast Mid Atlantic Mid West North East North West Pacific South Central South East South West Learn About 48 Hour Surface Forecast

The 48 hour Surface Analysis map shows current weather conditions, including frontal and high/low pressure positions, satellite infrared (IR) cloud cover, and areas of precipitation. A surface weather analysis is a special type of weather map that provides a view of weather elements over a geographical area at a specified time based on information from ground-based weather stations. Weather maps are created by plotting or tracing the values of relevant quantities such as sea level pressure, temperature, and cloud cover onto a geographical map to help find synoptic scale features such as weather fronts.

The first weather maps in the 19th century were drawn well after the fact to help devise a theory on storm systems. After the advent of the telegraph, simultaneous surface weather observations became possible for the first time, and beginning in the late 1840s, the Smithsonian Institution became the first organization to draw real-time surface analyses. Use of surface analyses began first in the United States, spreading worldwide during the 1870s. Use of the Norwegian cyclone model for frontal analysis began in the late 1910s across Europe, with its use finally spreading to the United States during World War II.

Surface weather analyses have special symbols which show frontal systems, cloud cover, precipitation, or other important information. For example, an H may represent high pressure, implying good and fair weather. An L on the other hand may represent low pressure, which frequently accompanies precipitation. Various symbols are used not just for frontal zones and other surface boundaries on weather maps, but also to depict the present weather at various locations on the weather map. Areas of precipitation help determine the frontal type and location.

[edit] English Wikipedia has an article on:menialWikipedia

Etymology

[edit]

From Middle English meyneal, from Anglo-Norman mesnal, from maisnee (“household”), from Vulgar Latin *mānsiōnāta, from Latin mānsiō (“house”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • enPR: mē'nēəl, IPA(key): /ˈmiːni.əl/
  • Audio (Southern England):Duration: 2 seconds.0:02(file)

Adjective

[edit]

menial (comparative more menial, superlative most menial)

  1. Of or relating to work normally performed by a servant. quotations ▼
    • 1837, L[etitia] E[lizabeth] L[andon], “Arrived at Home”, in Ethel Churchill: Or, The Two Brides. […], volume I, London: Henry Colburn, […], →OCLC, page 85:She hung round him, watching his every look as if she grudged the veriest menial offices from the servants; and she almost scolded him for not eating, when he had done justice enough to the good things set before him to have satisfied even the cook herself.
    • 1915, W[illiam] Somerset Maugham, chapter LXX, in Of Human Bondage, New York, N.Y.: George H[enry] Doran Company, →OCLC:She was not proposing to go out again, so he got her slippers and took off her boots. It delighted him to perform menial offices.
  2. Of or relating to unskilled work. quotations ▼menial job
    • 1910 October 1, G[ilbert] K[eith] Chesterton, “The Queer Feet”, in The Innocence of Father Brown, London, New York, N.Y.: Cassell and Company, published 1911, →OCLC:Father Brown took the paper without a word, and obediently went to look for the coat; it was not the first menial work he had done in his life.
    • 1913 August, Jack London, John Barleycorn, New York, N.Y.: The Century Co., →OCLC:I didn't see how sweeping and scrubbing a building was any preparation for the trade of electrician; but I did know that in the books all the boys started with the most menial tasks and by making good ultimately won to the ownership of the whole concern.
    • 2011, Chris Manning, Sudarno Sumarto, Employment, Living Standards and Poverty in Contemporary Indonesia, →ISBN:For instance, controlling for the above-mentioned variables, migrants to Tangerang or Samarinda (rather than Medan) have a significantly greater chance of getting a craft (as opposed to menial) job.
  3. Servile; low; mean. a menial wretch

Noun

[edit]

menial (plural menials)

  1. A servant, especially a domestic servant. quotations ▼
    • 1820, [Walter Scott], chapter 3, in The Abbot. […], volume I, Edinburgh: […] [James Ballantyne & Co.] for Longman, Hurst, Rees, Orme, and Brown, […]; and for Archibald Constable and Company, and John Ballantyne, […], →OCLC:“Nay, Dame Mary,” answered the Knight, “it is enough you desire such an attendant.—Yet I have never loved to nurse such useless menials—a lady's page—it may well suit the proud English dames to have a slender youth to bear their trains from bower to hall, fan them when they slumber, and touch the lute for them when they please to listen; […] ”
    • 1879, Henry James, Daisy Miller, London: Harper & Brothers:But the young man was conscious, at the same moment, that it had ceased to be a matter of serious regret to him that the little American flirt should be “talked about” by low-minded menials.
    • a. 1911, David Graham Phillips, Susan Lenox: Her Fall and Rise‎[1]:Was this stupid system, so cruel, so crushing, and producing at the top such absurd results as flashy, insolent autos and silly palaces and overfed, overdressed women, and dogs in jeweled collars, and babies of wealth brought up by low menials—was this system really the best?
    • 1913 December – 1914 March, Edgar Rice Burroughs, The Warlord of Mars, Chicago, Ill.: A[lexander] C[aldwell] McClurg & Co., published September 1919, →OCLC:He told me that princes, jeds, and even jeddaks of the outer world, were among the menials who served the yellow race; […]
    • 1922, Michael Arlen, “Ep./4/2”, in “Piracy”: A Romantic Chronicle of These Days:The world was awake to the 2nd of May, but Mayfair is not the world, and even the menials of Mayfair lie long abed.
  2. A person who has a subservient nature.

The Evolution of DEI: Trends and Priorities for 2024 and Beyond

  2. The Evolution of DEI: Trends and Priorities for 2024 and Beyond
Find JobsFREE ConsultOur Reviews

In 2024, the evolution of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiatives is marked by a focus on embracing intersectionality, prioritizing equity in hiring and advancement opportunities, and fostering inclusive leadership. Resource Employment Solutions recognizes the importance of staying abreast of these trends to drive meaningful change in the workplace. By acknowledging and addressing intersecting identities, implementing policies that promote equity, and fostering inclusive leadership at all levels, organizations can create environments where all employees feel valued and supported. Through tailored solutions and comprehensive services, Resource Employment Solutions is committed to supporting organizations in their DEI journey.

Contact UsCall Us

In the pursuit of creating inclusive and equitable workplaces, the landscape of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) continues to evolve. As we step into 2024, it's imperative to not only recognize the progress made but also to identify emerging trends and priorities shaping the DEI agenda. At Resource Employment Solutions, we are committed to fostering diverse and inclusive workplaces, and we believe that staying abreast of the latest DEI trends is essential for driving meaningful change.

At Resource Employment Solutions, we understand the transformative power of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) in shaping the future of work. As organizations navigate the complexities of DEI initiatives, we offer comprehensive solutions tailored to address the evolving needs of our clients and promote a culture of belonging.

Embracing Intersectionality in DEI Initiatives:

DEI efforts in 2024 are increasingly focusing on embracing intersectionality, recognizing that individuals hold multiple identities that intersect and influence their experiences in the workplace. For example, a woman of color may face unique challenges that differ from those of a white woman or a man of color. By acknowledging and addressing these intersecting identities, organizations can create more nuanced and inclusive DEI strategies. At Resource Employment Solutions, we advocate for intersectional approaches to DEI, ensuring that our initiatives consider the diverse experiences and perspectives of all employees.

Prioritizing Equity in Hiring and Advancement Opportunities:

In 2024, there is a growing emphasis on prioritizing equity in hiring and advancement opportunities. This involves implementing policies and practices that level the playing field for underrepresented groups and address systemic barriers to career progression. For instance, organizations may adopt blind hiring techniques to reduce unconscious bias or establish mentorship programs to support the development of diverse talent. Resource Employment Solutions offers customized recruitment and talent management solutions designed to promote equity and diversity in the workforce, helping our clients build inclusive teams that reflect the communities they serve.

Fostering Inclusive Leadership and Allyship:

Another key trend in DEI for 2024 is the emphasis on fostering inclusive leadership and allyship at all levels of the organization. Leaders play a critical role in championing DEI efforts and creating a culture where all employees feel valued and supported. This includes actively engaging in conversations about privilege, power dynamics, and systemic oppression, as well as advocating for inclusive policies and practices. Resource Employment Solutions provides leadership training and development programs that equip managers with the skills and knowledge needed to lead inclusively and act as allies for marginalized groups in the workplace.

As we navigate the evolving landscape of DEI in 2024 and beyond, it's clear that the journey towards creating truly inclusive workplaces is ongoing. At Resource Employment Solutions, we are committed to supporting organizations in their DEI efforts by offering comprehensive solutions tailored to their unique needs. Whether you're looking to embrace intersectionality, prioritize equity in hiring, or foster inclusive leadership, we're here to help.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is intersectionality, and why is it important in DEI efforts?

Intersectionality refers to the interconnected nature of social categorizations such as race, gender, and class, which create overlapping and interdependent systems of discrimination and disadvantage. In DEI efforts, intersectionality is important because it recognizes that individuals hold multiple identities that intersect and influence their experiences in the workplace. Acknowledging intersectionality helps organizations develop more inclusive strategies that address the diverse needs of all employees.

How can organizations prioritize equity in hiring and advancement opportunities?

Organizations can prioritize equity in hiring and advancement opportunities by implementing policies and practices that level the playing field for underrepresented groups and address systemic barriers to career progression. This may include adopting blind hiring techniques to reduce unconscious bias, establishing mentorship programs to support the development of diverse talent, and implementing pay equity measures to ensure fair compensation for all employees.

What role do leaders play in fostering inclusive workplaces?

Leaders play a critical role in fostering inclusive workplaces by championing DEI efforts, modeling inclusive behaviors, and creating a culture where all employees feel valued and supported. This involves actively engaging in conversations about privilege, power dynamics, and systemic oppression, as well as advocating for inclusive policies and practices. Inclusive leadership helps create environments where diverse perspectives are respected, and all employees have the opportunity to thrive.

What is trademark infringement?
Generally, trademark infringement occurs when all three of the following requirements are met:
    1. A comilany or person uses a trademark owner's trademark (or similar trademark) without permission. 2. That use is in commerce, meaning that it's done in connection with the sale or promotion of goods or services. 3. That use is likely to confuse consumers about the source, endorsement or affiliation of the goods or services.

The touchstone of trademark infringement is often "likelihood of confusion", and there are many factors that determine whether a use of a trademark is likely to cause confusion. For example, when a person's trademark is also used by someone else, but on unrelated goods or services, that use may not be infringement because it may not cause confusion. Which party used the trademark first can often be an important consideration as well.

Table of Contents

  1. 1Ypsilanti's Environmental Injustices Today

A Very Brief History of Ypsilanti

Native Americans

Long before Ypsilanti was known as Ypsilanti, the area was inhabited primarily by the Potawatomi and Wyandot Indians, among other Native American tribes.○Open citation. They built trails throughout the city, one of which is now Michigan Avenue (highlighted in yellow), and settlements just south of present-day Michigan AvenueJump to Edgenote (triangle also highlighted in yellow).Photo credit:Mark Maynard1931 Hinsdale map of current-day Ypsilanti area showing Native American settlements prior to 1800sReturn to narrativeBy the 1830s, Native Americans were forcibly removed from newly incorporated City of YpsilantiJump to Edgenote and the larger Southeast Michigan area as White Europeans developed trading posts and villages in the area. Throughout this time and the decades that followed, Ypsilanti became critical settlement for Black slaves escaping the south along the Underground RailroadJump to Edgenote. Where these Black communities were allowed to settle isn’t surprising. Learn more about how Ypsilanti got it's unique namecityofypsilanti.com ›Return to narrativeLearn more about the Underground Railroad in Ypsilantiyoutube.com ›Return to narrative

Black Americans

The vast majority of Black residents were segregated to the southside of YpslantiJump to Edgenote – south of Michigan Avenue – where the former Native American settlements were located.Throughout the late 1800s and early 1900s, life for Black residents of Ypsilanti told a similar story to other Black Americans at the time – a story of segregation. Segregated homes. Segregated schools. Segregated restaurants. A former Black Ypsilanti teacher, Marguerite Eaglin, tells a storyJump to Edgenote of how segregation looked like during the 1950s in the city.

African American Ypsilanti, 1910. - Google My Maps

google.com ›Return to narrative“They finally served us, but they burned the bread”— Marguerite Eaglin, ca. 1980sReturn to narrative“…and the fact that because I was black, there were restaurants downtown that didn’t want us to come and eat. My children told me the story about how good Haab’s french fries were, but they had to stand outside and buy them from the window if they wanted any. I wasn’t aware of that. My friend Yvonne Williams and I would go downtown for lunch and we’d go into a place and sit and sit and sit. I was teaching school, so I only had so much time for lunch. Nobody actively insulted us, but they just didn’t wait on us. They just ignored us like we weren’t there. Finally in one place, I said, “Look, I have to go back to school. Do you know when we could get served, please?” They finally served us, but they burned the bread.” – Marguerite Eaglin, ca. 1980sJump to EdgenoteRead more about Marguerite Eaglin's storyhistory.ypsilibrary.org ›Return to narrativeStories like Marguerite Eaglin’s are important to understanding the lived experiences of residents in small cities. While her story tells us about the segregation she and other Black residents faced out and about in restaurants, others’ stories speak on the different dimensions of segregation. Could these stories uncover the legacy of redlining in Ypsilanti? Could they explain not only why Ypsilanti remains so racially segregated, but also the racial segregation in environmental pollution?Next: Uncovering Ypsilanti's Historical Redlining © 2016 – 2025 The Regents of the University of Michigan Get Help Open Source v2.2.0

What is Trademark Infringement?

Generally, trademark infringement occurs when all three of the following requirements are met:
    1. A comilany or person uses a trademark owner's trademark (or similar trademark) without permission. 2. That use is in commerce, meaning that it's done in connection with the sale or promotion of goods or services. 3. That use is likely to confuse consumers about the source, endorsement or affiliation of the goods or services.

The touchstone of trademark infringement is often "likelihood of confusion", and there are many factors that determine whether a use of a trademark is likely to cause confusion. For example, when a person's trademark is also used by someone else, but on unrelated goods or services, that use may not be infringement because it may not cause confusion. Which party used the trademark first can often be an important consideration as well.

Trademark dilution

Trademark dilution may also be unlawful in certain countries. Dilution, which applies to famous trademarks, may occur in certain circumstances when a trademark is used without permission in commerce. Examples of dilution can include blurring (using the mark for unrelated goods or services in a way that weakens the distinctiveness of the mark) or tarnishment (using the mark in an unflattering or offensive way).

Autorisation de conduite et CACES : quelles différences ?

25.09.2023

/ CACES

De nombreuses questions se posent concernant l’autorisation de conduite et le CACES. Quelles sont leurs différences ? Lequel est obligatoire pour conduire un engin CACES ? Découvrez à quoi correspond une autorisation de conduite et les différences qui existent avec le CACES. Le CNFCE, organisme de formation pour les entreprises, vous explique tout cela en détail.

Qu’est-ce qu’une autorisation de conduite ? Définition

L’autorisation de conduite est un document remis par un employeur, permettant d’attester de la capacité d’un employé à conduire un de ces équipements de travail mobiles :

  • Chariots élévateurs de manutention (CACES cariste R489)
  • Grues à tour (CACES R487)
  • Grues mobiles (CACES R483)
  • Engins de chantier (CACES R482)
  • Nacelles/plateformes élévatrices mobiles de personne (CACES R486)
  • Grues de chargement (CACES R490)

Pour l’utilisation de ces appareils de levage, l’employeur doit répondre à ses obligations en faisant former ses salariés, et en leur remettant une autorisation de conduite.

Les différences entre autorisation de conduite et CACES

L’autorisation de conduite

Une autorisation de conduite est un document valable uniquement dans l’entreprise dans laquelle il a été délivré. Un employé sera obligé d’obtenir une autorisation de conduite de la part de son employeur, à chaque fois qu’il change d’entreprise. Il s’agit d’une obligation inscrite dans le Code du travail.

Le CACES

Le CACES correspond à une évaluation des connaissances et de la maîtrise d’un ou plusieurs engins du référentiel CACES. Ce certificat d’aptitude à la conduite en sécurité a une durée de validité de 5 à 10 ans (en fonction du type de CACES).

Cela signifie que le détenteur d’un certificat CACES peut le faire valoir dans d’autres entreprises, tant que celui est valide. On parle aussi de « permis CACES ».

NB : Posséder un CACES ne signifie pas posséder une autorisation de conduite. Une certification CACES, obtenue après avoir suivi une formation CACES, atteste de sa capacité et de ses connaissances à utiliser un engin du référentiel CACES en toute sécurité, et permet donc d’être habilité par l’entreprise à recevoir l’autorisation de conduite.

Pour conduire un engin de levage et de manutention, le CACES n’est donc pas obligatoire, mais fortement conseillé.

Comment obtenir une autorisation de conduite ?

La délivrance de l’autorisation de conduite doit respecter ces prérequis :

  • Contrôle de l’aptitude médicale. Le futur conducteur doit posséder un certificat médical valide et être en bonne santé
  • Être âgé de 18 ans
  • Maîtrise de la langue française (lue, écrite, parlée)
  • Connaissance des lieux et des instructions à respecter sur le site d’utilisation
  • Capacités à utiliser l’engin sur lequel le stagiaire a été formé
  • Réussite aux examens de contrôle des connaissances, à l’issue d’une formation

Pour obtenir une autorisation de conduite, l’employé doit obligatoirement suivre une formation CACES visant à développer ses connaissances et son savoir-faire.

Deux options :

  • Dans le cadre d’une formation interne, au sein de l’entreprise, le formateur CACES doit disposer de toutes les connaissances et expériences nécessaires pour exercer cette tâche.
  • Dans le cadre d’une formation externe, l’employeur peut faire appel à un organisme de formation spécialisé, si aucun salarié n’est apte à dispenser des formations en interne, pour former ses collaborateurs et leur permettre d’acquérir l’autorisation de conduite/CACES adapté à leurs missions.
NB : Un salarié peut utiliser un engin uniquement sur lequel il a été formé. S’il n’a été formé que sur une seule catégorie d’engins, comme les chariots de manutention (ex : CACES R489 catégorie 3), il n’est autorisé à utiliser que cette seule catégorie.

L’autorisation de conduite est-elle obligatoire ?

Le Code du travail stipule que « La conduite des équipements de travail mobiles automoteurs et des équipements de travail servant au levage est réservée aux travailleurs qui ont reçu une formation adéquate. Cette formation est complétée et réactualisée chaque fois que nécessaire. » Source : Article R4323-55

L’utilisation des engins de levage présente de nombreux risques, et est donc fortement réglementée. Le chef d’entreprise doit ainsi s’assurer que ces salariés soient formés à la prévention des risques liés à l’utilisation de ces engins. L’autorisation de conduite est donc obligatoire.

Qui peut délivrer l’attestation de conduite ?

Seul l’employeur est autorisé à délivrer l’attestation de conduite.

Le CNFCE, organisme de formation professionnelle en CACES

Le CNFCE propose la majorité des formations CACES, pour permettre aux entreprises de former leurs salariés. Découvrez notre catalogue pour passer le CACES adapté aux besoins de votre entreprise.

Contactez-nous pour obtenir des informations sur nos conditions d’inscription et de financement. Découvrez également notre foire aux questions CACES, pour en savoir plus sur cette thématique.

Nos formations s’adressent uniquement à des salariés en poste. Si vous êtes un particulier ou à la recherche d’un emploi, nous vous invitons à contacter un organisme adapté à votre profil.

From Minneapolis

  • Take 35W to Burnsville.

  • Take Exit 1, which is County Road 42.

  • Turn left (east) on County Road 42.  Continue through two stoplights until you pass under the 35E bridge and come to a third stoplight (exit ramp for 35E).

  • Go to the very next street, which is Grand Avenue (frontage road for 35E); turn right then make an immediate left (you will see our brown brick building).

  • Turn right into our upper lot; this is the main entrance.

From St. Paul

  • Take 35E south to Burnsville.

  • Take Exit 88B, which is County Road 42.

  • Turn left (east) onto County Road 42 and go under 35E.  You will come to a stoplight (exit ramp for 35E).

  • Go to the very next street which is Grand Avenue (frontage road for 35E) and turn right; then make an immediate left (you will see our brown brick building).

  • Turn right into our upper lot; this is the main entrance. 

  Back to top  

From the South

  • Take 35 north to 35E north to Burnsville. 

  • Exit on County Road 42.

  • Go east on County Road 42 (right) to the very next street, which is Grand Avenue South (frontage road for 35E). 

  • Turn right onto Grand Avenue, and then an immediate left (you will see our brown brick building).

  • Turn right into our upper lot; this is the main entrance.

If you miss Grand Avenue you will come to Plymouth Avenue. Turn right onto Plymouth Avenue and then right again into the parking lot of Good Shepherd Lutheran Church and School.  Proceed slowly through the parking lot of Good Shepherd until you come to our brown brick office building and park in the upper lot. When school is in session (8:15 am – 3:00 pm), please use the instructions below.

When Good Shepherd School is in Session (8 am - 3 pm)

After turning on Plymouth Avenue, go past Good Shepherd’s parking lot. Continue on Plymouth Ave/145th Street, going around the back of Good Shepherd Lutheran School. Turn right on Grand Avenue South and right again after Havenwood Senior Living to enter our parking lot.

To leave, you will need to go back the same way when the traffic cones are in place. Otherwise, you can proceed slowly through Good Shepherd’s parking lot.

The office of the clerk of circuit court is part of the Wisconsin judicial system and the responsibilities are governed by state statute and Wisconsin Supreme Court Rules. Concurrent Planning for Timely Permanency for Children

Date: August 2021

Series Title: State Statutes Series

Author(s): Information Gateway

Year Published: 2021

File Size: 447 KB

Current Through: 08-31-2021

Download Publication concurrent-planning-timely-permanency.pdf (PDF 447 KB)

This publication presents an overview of State laws and policies that provide for the development and implementation of an alternative permanency plan concurrently with efforts to reunify the child with his or her family. Compared with more traditional sequential planning for permanency, in which one permanency plan is ruled out before an alternative is developed, concurrent planning may provide earlier permanency for a child. This publication presents a general overview of this aspect of child welfare law. Summaries of laws on this topic for all individual States and U.S. territories are available from the State Statutes Search page.

This publication is a product of the State Statutes Series prepared by Child Welfare Information Gateway. While every attempt has been made to be as complete as possible, additional information on these topics may be in other sections of a State's code as well as agency regulations, case law, and informal practices and procedures.

This material may be freely reproduced and distributed. However, when doing so, please credit Child Welfare Information Gateway.

Suge Knight calls out Jay-Z, Snoop Dogg and more for not “stepping up” after Diddy arrest

He also doubled down on his conspiracy that Diddy was an FBI informant

By Kyann-Sian Williams 27th September 2024 (From left to right) Suge Knight, Jay-Z, Snoop Dogg and Diddy. Photo credit: Pool David McNew/Getty Images; Monica Schipper/WireImage; Alexander Tamargo/Getty Images; Shareif Ziyadat/Getty Images

Suge Knight has slammed Jay-Z, Snoop Dogg and more for being silent and not “stepping up” after Diddy‘s recent arrest.

Earlier this month, Diddy – real name Sean Combs – was arrested and charged with racketeering conspiracy, sex trafficking by force, fraud or coercion and transportation to engage in prostitution. He has since been detained in Brooklyn’s Metropolitan Detention Center,

Advertisement

This week (September 25), Knight spoke to Chris Cuomo on NewsNation from prison – where he is serving 28 years for a 2015 fatal hit-and-run – and called out some of the biggest rappers for not denouncing Combs’ behaviour.

“I look at it real plain and simple: [I] ain’t no whistleblower,” he said over the phone. “The facts [are] there but, right now, I don’t care if it’s T.I., I don’t care if it’s Rick Ross, I don’t care if it’s Jay[-Z], I don’t care if it’s Snoop [Dogg], I don’t care if it’s [The] Game, I don’t care if it’s Drake, nobody is stepping up.”

Some rappers have commented on Diddy’s recent arrests. 50 Cent has always spoken out against the rap mogul and is even making a documentary about Combs and his crimes.

LL Cool J was asked his opinions on Diddy’s arrest while on the red carpet for the Black Music Action Coalition gala, to which he said he has none but he “feels for his kids.” At the same event, Flavor Flav told Sky News: “You know what, I’mma tell you, when anybody asks me my opinion on Diddy, you know what my opinion is? I have none. I ain’t got no answers for a Diddy question. None.”

Recommended

Former Bad Boy signee Shyne said Diddy “destroyed” his life after the latter refused to take any responsibility for a December 1999 nightclub shooting that injured three people. During the trial, Shyne was sentenced to prison, while Combs was acquitted of all charges – a decision that the current Belize politician has criticised.

Knight also shared his thoughts on Diddy’s criminal behaviour in his NewsNation interview, claiming that the ‘Bad Boy For Life’ star “repeated what was done to him” and many in the music industry “knew what was going on”.

The LA businessman also theorised that Combs won’t have an open-and-shut case due to his powerful connections.

“He’s not a dummy so he’s smart enough to work his magic,” Knight explained. “On top of that, he’s been involved with the FBI for most of his career. He got powerful people. One of his partners who started his company with drug money, President Obama got him out of prison!”

Advertisement

The 59-year-old added: “So it’s not like he don’t have no moves. I don’t think nobody should just count him out. I don’t think he’s gonna lay down and curl in the corner and die.”

Sean ‘Diddy’ Combs attends Sean ‘Diddy’ Combs Fulfills $1 Million Pledge To Howard University At Howard Homecoming – Yardfest at Howard University on October 20, 2023 in Washington, DC (CREDIT: Shareif Ziyadat/Getty Images for Sean ‘Diddy’ Combs)

The Death Row co-founder also commented on the news that Diddy is on suicide watch and is “paranoid” about being poisoned.

“I don’t wanna say he’s in danger and neither should he say that,” he said. “Because once he gets to the point where they feel he’s gonna be suicidal, you don’t have the rights to nothing: no sock, no drawers, no T-shirt, no blanket, no sheets. You’re naked in a cell as a crazy man, so he definitely don’t wanna do that.”

Last November, Diddy’s former girlfriend and label signee Cassie Ventura filed the first in a series of sexual abuse lawsuits against him. The duo settled the case a day after it was filed.

Rodney ‘Lil Rod’ Jones – a producer and contributor for Combs’ latest album, ‘The Love Album: Off The Grid’ – filed his own case against Diddy, claiming that he drugged him, forcing him to have sex with prostitutes, and held parties where underage girls and sex workers were present. The lawsuit is still ongoing and Diddy denied the allegation.

This month, two more women have pressed charges against Diddy. On September 12, Danity Kane and Diddy Dirty Money member Dawn Richards said her former boss sexually assaulted her, deprived her of food and sleep and refused to pay her adequately. She also stated that she witnessed Combs abuse Ventura. Combs also retains his innocence and denies Richards’ claims.

Two weeks later, a woman came forward and said Diddy and his bodyguard drugged, raped her and filmed the incident in 2001. The alleged victim, Thalia Graves, claimed she has suffered from depression, anxiety and panic attacks ever since the incident. Diddy continues to deny her claim and all wrongdoing.

Ik voel me benauwd

Als je benauwd bent, voelt het alsof je niet genoeg adem en lucht krijgt. Andere woorden die gebruikt worden voor benauwdheid zijn: kortademigheid, buiten adem zijn, ademnood, of naar lucht happen. Met een moeilijk woord wordt benauwdheid ook wel dyspneu genoemd.

Hoe voelt benauwdheid?

Benauwd zijn voelt alsof je (te) weinig lucht krijgt. Soms kunnen mensen niet goed diep inademen. Ze nemen dan korte ademteugen. Andere mensen gaan juist dieper of sneller ademen. Een beklemmend gevoel op de borst, piepende ademhaling of pijn bij het ademhalen komen ook voor.

Je benauwd voelen is erg naar en kan eng zijn. Voor sommige mensen voelt het als (bijna) stikken. Als je iets wilt doen terwijl je benauwd bent, is dat vaak lastiger. Bij benauwdheid ben je sneller moe en heb je minder energie.

COPD-risicotest

Veel mensen hebben groot risico op COPD, zonder dat ze het zelf weten. Doe hier de test, dan zie je meteen of je risico loopt op COPD. Invullen kost maar één minuut.

Doe de test

Is het erg om benauwd te zijn?

Als je je inspant, heeft je lichaam meer zuurstof nodig. Bijvoorbeeld tijdens sporten of als je een hoge trap oploopt. Dan is het ook niet raar om je benauwd te voelen.

Als je kortademig bent bij inspanning én als je rustig aan doet, dan kan er meer aan de hand zijn. Ook is het goed om op te letten als je benauwd bent bij gewone dagelijkse bezigheden zoals een stukje wandelen, douchen, licht werk in huis of tuin of de trap oplopen. Ook als je kortademig bent tijdens activiteiten die je eerst zonder problemen kon doen, kan er meer aan de hand zijn. Als benauwd zijn je beperkt bij deze dagelijkse dingen, is er misschien meer aan de hand.

Weet dat je meer kunt doen aan je klachten dan je denkt.

Chris Spaan, heeft COPD Lees zijn verhaal

Wat kan ik doen als ik vaak benauwd ben?

Als je vaker benauwd bent, is het goed om te kijken of daar een reden voor is. Misschien kan er dan ook iets aan gedaan worden.

Het is goed om naar de huisarts te gaan als één (of meer) van de volgende beweringen voor jou geldt:

  • Je merkt dat je vaak benauwd bent in het dagelijkse leven.
  • Je merkt dat je steeds vaker benauwd bent (in vergelijking met bijvoorbeeld een half jaar geleden).
  • Je bent benauwd bij (lichte) inspanning of je kunt je steeds minder goed inspannen.
  • Je bent benauwd in rust.
  • Je benauwdheid beperkt je in je dagelijkse bezigheden (je kunt bijvoorbeeld de hond niet meer uitlaten).
  • Je kan niet plat liggen omdat je dan kortademig wordt.
  • Je ademt heel snel, wel meer dan twintig keer per minuut.
  • Je bent benauwd en hebt last van andere klachten zoals koorts, hoesten of een piepende ademhaling.
  • Je bent benauwd en hebt pijn op de borst.

Weet je niet zeker of wat jij voelt goed is? Je kunt je zorgen altijd bespreken met de huisarts. Hij of zij kan dan samen met je kijken of er iets aan de hand is en hoe je geholpen kunt worden.

COPD-risicotest

300.000 mensen hebben een groot risico op COPD, zonder dat ze het zelf weten. Doe gratis de test en zie meteen of je risico loopt op COPD. Invullen duurt maar 1 minuut.

Doe nu de COPD risicotest

Andere klachten die vaak samengaan met benauwdheid

Benauwdheid staat soms niet op zichzelf. Misschien heb je ook last van de volgende klachten:

  • Hoesten

    Hoesten is een natuurlijke reactie van het lichaam. Het is bedoeld om de keel, luchtpijp en longen schoon te maken.

    Lees meer Hoesten

  • Slijm (ophoesten)

    Als je last hebt van veel slijm, dan kan het zijn dat je moeilijk slikt of meer moet hoesten.

    Lees meer Slijm (ophoesten)

  • Weinig energie of vaak moe

    Als je weinige energie hebt of snel moe bent, is het goed om eerst te kijken of je daar zelf een reden voor kunt vinden.

    Lees meer Weinig energie of vaak moe

  • Piepende ademhaling

    Als je vaak een piepende of brommende ademhaling hebt, is het goed om te kijken of daar een reden voor is.

    Lees meer Piepende ademhaling

  • Zijn je klachten opeens erger?

    Bij een longaanval zijn klachten (bijvoorbeeld hoesten, slijm en benauwdheid) opeens veel erger.

    Lees meer Zijn je klachten opeens erger?

Steun onderzoek naar COPD

In Nederland leven 600.000 mensen met de longziekte COPD en nog meer mensen zónder diagnose. Dankzij jouw bijdrage is meer onderzoek mogelijk. Help jij mee?

MetaMask® Extension - Browser extension - webflow

In the rapidly evolving landscape of blockchain technology, MetaMask stands out as a cornerstone tool, empowering users to navigate the decentralized web with ease and security. At its core, MetaMask is an extension for web browsers that serves as a bridge between traditional web interfaces and blockchain-based applications. With its intuitive interface and robust features, MetaMask has become indispensable for cryptocurrency enthusiasts, developers, and everyday users alike.

The installation process for MetaMask is straightforward, typically requiring just a few clicks to add the extension to your preferred web browser, such as Google Chrome, Firefox, or Brave. Once installed, MetaMask prompts users to create a new wallet or import an existing one using a seed phrase or private key. This initial setup is crucial, as it establishes the foundation for securely managing digital assets and interacting with decentralized applications.

One of the key features of MetaMask is its cryptocurrency wallet functionality. Users can store, send, and receive a variety of digital assets, including popular cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum, as well as tokens issued on these blockchains. MetaMask employs industry-standard encryption techniques to protect user data, ensuring that sensitive information remains secure at all times. Additionally, MetaMask supports the integration of hardware wallets for enhanced security, providing users with peace of mind knowing that their funds are safeguarded against unauthorized access.

Beyond its role as a cryptocurrency wallet, MetaMask serves as a gateway to the world of decentralized finance (DeFi). Through MetaMask, users can access a wide range of DeFi protocols and platforms, including decentralized exchanges (DEXs), lending and borrowing platforms, and yield farming protocols. This seamless integration enables users to participate in decentralized finance activities directly from their browser, without the need for intermediary services or centralized exchanges. Whether you're looking to swap tokens, earn interest on your assets, or provide liquidity to decentralized liquidity pools, MetaMask provides the tools you need to engage with the burgeoning DeFi ecosystem.

MetaMask's compatibility with various blockchain networks further enhances its utility and versatility. While initially designed for the Ethereum blockchain, MetaMask has expanded its support to include other networks such as Binance Smart Chain and Polygon (formerly Matic Network). This multi-chain compatibility enables users to access a diverse array of decentralized applications and services, catering to different use cases and preferences within the blockchain space. Whether you're exploring decentralized gaming, decentralized identity solutions, or decentralized social networks, MetaMask offers seamless connectivity to a wide range of blockchain networks and protocols.

The user interface of MetaMask is designed with simplicity and accessibility in mind, making it easy for both newcomers and experienced users to navigate the decentralized web. The extension provides a familiar browsing experience, with features such as account management, transaction history, and customizable settings readily accessible within a few clicks. Additionally, MetaMask offers support for mobile devices through its mobile app, allowing users to manage their digital assets and interact with DApps on the go.

In conclusion, MetaMask extension plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of the decentralized web, empowering users to take control of their digital assets and participate in the burgeoning ecosystem of blockchain-based applications and services. With its seamless browser integration, robust security features, and compatibility with multiple blockchain networks, MetaMask has become an essential tool for anyone interested in exploring the possibilities of decentralized innovation. Whether you're a cryptocurrency enthusiast, a developer building decentralized applications, or simply curious about the potential of blockchain technology, MetaMask provides a user-friendly gateway to the decentralized web.

Trezor.io/Start®

Visit Trezor.io/start (version 22.9.3) to secure your digital assets. The latest update offers advanced protection and improved features for your Trezor hardware wallet.

Getting Started with Trezor.io/start: Your Ultimate Guide to Secure Cryptocurrency Management

Navigating the world of cryptocurrency can be daunting, but Trezor makes it simple and secure. If you’re new to Trezor or need a refresher, this guide on Trezor.io/start will help you get set up quickly and securely.

What is Trezor?

Trezor is a leading hardware wallet designed to keep your cryptocurrency safe from online threats. Unlike software wallets, which are vulnerable to hacking, Trezor stores your private keys offline. This makes it nearly impossible for hackers to access your assets. Whether you are a seasoned crypto investor or just starting, Trezor offers a robust solution to keep your investments safe.

Why Trezor.io/start?

The Trezor.io/start page is your entry point to setting up your Trezor device. It’s designed to make the setup process as smooth and straightforward as possible. From this page, you can download the Trezor Suite, the software that helps you manage your crypto assets, and follow step-by-step instructions to get started.

How to Get Started

  1. Visit Trezor.io/start: Open your web browser and go to Trezor.io/start. This page provides all the necessary resources to set up your Trezor device, including download links and user guides.

  2. Download the Trezor Suite: The Trezor Suite is an all-in-one application that lets you manage your crypto assets securely. It is available for both desktop and mobile platforms. Download and install the version that suits your device.

  3. Connect Your Trezor Device: Once the Trezor Suite is installed, connect your Trezor hardware wallet to your computer or mobile device using the provided USB cable. The Trezor Suite will automatically detect your device and guide you through the initial setup.

  4. Create a New Wallet: If this is your first time using Trezor, you’ll need to create a new wallet. The Trezor Suite will walk you through this process, including generating a recovery seed—a series of words that can be used to recover your wallet if your device is lost or damaged. Keep this recovery seed in a safe place, as it is the only way to restore your funds.

  5. Start Managing Your Crypto Assets: After setting up your wallet, you can start sending, receiving, and managing your cryptocurrencies. The Trezor Suite provides a user-friendly interface that makes it easy to monitor your portfolio, execute transactions, and even exchange one cryptocurrency for another.

Why Security Matters

In the rapidly evolving world of cryptocurrency, security is paramount. Trezor’s offline storage method ensures that your private keys are never exposed to the internet, protecting your assets from phishing attacks, malware, and other online threats. By following the setup guide at Trezor.io/start, you’re taking the first step toward safeguarding your investments.

External Resources

For further reading and to enhance your understanding of cryptocurrency security, consider exploring these external resources:

  • Trezor Security Practices - Learn about the advanced security features that make Trezor the trusted choice for cryptocurrency holders.

  • CoinMarketCap - Stay updated on cryptocurrency prices and market trends.

  • Crypto Security 101 - A comprehensive guide to protecting your digital assets.

Conclusion

Setting up your Trezor wallet through Trezor.io/start is a straightforward process that significantly enhances the security of your cryptocurrency holdings. By following the steps outlined above, you can ensure that your digital assets are protected against potential threats. Don't compromise on security—take the time to set up your Trezor device properly and rest easy knowing your investments are safe.

                                                                              The Benefits of Small-Group Instruction: In No Small Way

                                                                              Whole-class teaching is an efficient way to ensure that all students get access to the same information at once. But it also invites a lot of problems! Students are unlikely to follow and remember everything being said, plus they may not feel comfortable asking questions in front of all of their peers. One-on-one tutoring is a way to get around those issues and ensure a student gets targeted, focused support. But when other students aren’t present, the social part of learning takes a hit, and students are unable to engage in mathematical discourse. Moreover, how can a classroom teacher possibly tutor everyone one-on-one?

                                                                              Both whole-class instruction and one-on-one tutoring must happen to some extent in a classroom, but the place where the magic happens—where a light bulb flickers on the most—is in small groups.

                                                                              What Is Small-Group Instruction?

                                                                              Small-group instruction, or small-group teaching, refers to classroom instruction where the teacher is teaching a small group of students. It falls in between whole-class instruction, where the teacher addresses the whole class at once, and one-on-one individual instruction, where the teacher is working with a single student. It is distinct from students working in a small group without a teacher.

                                                                              implementing small-group instruction in the classroomimplementing small-group instruction in the classroomWaggleMath 180Math 180Read 180

                                                                              The Purpose of Small-Group Instruction

                                                                              Small-group instruction is at the heart of where instruction happens. It enables teachers to focus on a specific concept for which some students are performing below grade level and address the needs of just those students. Small-group instruction also provides an environment conducive to reteaching concepts to specific students who need extra support or pushing students who are ready for more advanced concepts.

                                                                              multi-tiered systems of supportsmall-group reading instruction strategies

                                                                              Why Is Small-Group Instruction Important in the Classroom?

                                                                              small-group instruction is of high value

                                                                              teachers are able to work at a more individualized level

                                                                              Small-Group Instruction Benefits

                                                                              Research suggests that small-group instruction results in more learning than students not instructed in small groups. After all, small-group instruction strikes a balance between individual tutoring, which is effective but not scalable, with whole-class instruction, which is efficient but not as effective. There are plenty of evidence-backed benefits that come from small-group instruction. To name a few:

                                                                              • Students retain big ideas from their instruction better. (Cooper et al., 2000)
                                                                              • More students participate. (Pollock et al., 2011)
                                                                              • Students are better able to generalize prior knowledge. (Pai et al., 2014)

                                                                                • Teachers should not incorporate small-group instruction simply to check a box, however. “It is important to consider whether pulled-small-group instruction is appropriate for your particular learning goal,” write Juli Dixon and colleagues (2019). Small-group instruction should always serve the student's needs, though its application is far-reaching, including intervention, enrichment, and core grade-appropriate tasks.

                                                                                Advantages and Disadvantages of Small-Group Teaching

                                                                                Cooper et al. (2000) in particular walk through not just the benefits, but explain nuances and misconceptions that address worries that many teachers have before implementing small-group instruction. For instance, teachers are reasonably concerned about reduced content coverage, student resistance, or additional prep time needed. Yet the authors insist that “lecture and small-group work must be framed as both/and endeavors, not either/or ones” (p. 63). That is to say, implementing small-group instruction asks a lot of teachers, but the payoff is worth it.

                                                                                Advantages of Small-Group Teaching

                                                                                provides more opportunities for differentiated instruction

                                                                                According to Wieselmann et al. (2019), small-group learning is particularly integral to STEM achievement. Recent educational reforms emphasize “group work, argumentation, and complex problem solving,” all specific, important benefits that come with small-group instruction. These may be soft skills, but they lead to outcomes—like persistence, motivation, and attitude—necessary to succeed in the hard sciences. “The application of knowledge often occurs through small group activities, as groups of students work together to solve real-world problems.”

                                                                                Disadvantages of Small-Group Teaching

                                                                                In teaching, of course, there is no “perfect.” Strategies come with concessions. Plus, no two students or teachers are perfectly alike. One common challenge is that students can fail to work cohesively or respectfully (Linnenbrink-Garcia et al., 2011). Merely placing students in a group with a teacher does not guarantee that the students will work well together. The teacher’s task of assembling small groups can be a tough one.

                                                                                Succeeding in small-group instruction also requires experience or instruction in group work, a point made by John Hattie: “A consistent message from studies of the effectiveness of . . . small-group sessions is that students may need to be taught skills of working in groups” (2023, p. 191). That is, successful small-group instruction relies on successful small groups, and teachers should be open to providing explicit instruction on collaboration and understanding that students may struggle with it.

                                                                                Implementing Small-Group Instruction in the Classroom

                                                                                Implementing small-group instruction with rotations is no small task. It requires explicit instruction, modeling, and practice to make it all work, where some students are in a small group with the teacher, while everyone else participates in rotations of independent or collaborative work. It can take a while to come together, and teachers may need to let things get bumpy at times before classroom instruction clicks into place. It is worth the time though; students learn to work independently and in collaboration with others, and teachers get to provide focused help with the potential for great gains.

What Are the Requirements for a Mexican Passport?

legal

By William Leborgne | Published 10/28/2022

Getting a Mexican Passport inside or outside the US is an easy and quick process. If you’re Mexican and have never applied for it—or maybe it expired or was lost—read our guide to learn what you need to get a new one.

It’s one of the most important documents and you don’t want to wait until you really need it!

Procedure to Apply for a Mexican Passport

The process of getting your passport is relatively simple if you know the requirements and gather the necessary documents in advance. These are the steps to follow to complete the process:

  1. Schedule an appointment. Use the SREs appointment portal. You must indicate whether you wish to make your application at a Consular Office abroad or a liaison office of the SRE. You’ll then choose the date and time of your appointment depending on the availability of the selected office.
  2. Bring the necessary documents to your appointment. The records required to obtain your passport will depend on your specific case. In the following section, we'll show you which documents you might need and in which circumstances.
  3. Receive your new passport. Passports are delivered the same day if you process your passport in the US or a consulate within the US. If you initiate the process from a consulate in another country, it may take up to 30 days for your document to arrive (except for emergency passports).

First-Time Passport Issuance 

Applying for a Mexican passport for the first time is very similar to applying for a renewal or replacement passport. The main difference when you apply for it for the first time is that you must prove your Mexican nationality with documentation, such as a birth certificate or naturalization letter.

Passport Renewal

It's much simpler when it comes to renewals, as your expired passport serves as proof of your nationality. Unlike a first-time issuance, you don’t need to present another document proving your nationality.

Minors

In addition to complying with all the standard requirements, all minors must present themselves with their legal guardian(s). The father, mother, or guardian must prove their identity by showing a valid official identification that matches the name mentioned on the minor's birth certificate or letter of naturalization (with copy). Valid documents for this purpose are:

  • Mexican passport
  • National Electoral Institute (INE/IFE) voting card
  • Professional license
  • Professional degree
  • Letter of internship
  • Released National Military Service ID card
  • National Institute for the Elderly (INAPAM) credential
  • Identity card
  • Certificate of high-security consular registration
  • Letter of naturalization
  • Certificate of Mexican nationality
  • Declaration of Mexican nationality by birth
  • Credentials for medical services from a public health or social security institution
  • Credential for retirees or pensioners
  • National credential for People with Disabilities
  • Foreign passport
  • Visitor's or resident's card issued by the National Immigration Institute (INM)

Required Documents

We suggest that you get the necessary documents for your procedure even before making the appointment at your nearest office. The documents that the Mexican government may ask you to provide for the issuance of a passport are:

Proof of Mexican Nationality

Only Mexican nationals may apply for a passport from the Mexican government. Therefore, if you're applying for a passport for the first time, you must prove your nationality before the Liaison Office or Consular Office by presenting one of the following documents: 

  • Certified birth certificate issued by the Mexican Civil Registry Office (original)
  • Certified birth certificate issued by a Consular Office (original)
  • Letter of naturalization (in original and copy)
  • Declaration of Mexican nationality by birth (original and copy)
  • Certificate of Mexican nationality (original and copy)

Keep in mind: You’ll need to present additional information when your birth certificate has been issued three years after you were born.

Proof of Identity

Government agencies need to issue passports to ensure that applicants are who they say they are. To prove your identity, you must present at least one of the following documents in original and copy:

  • Voting Credential from the National Electoral Institute (INE/IFE)
  • Professional License
  • Professional Degree
  • Letter of Graduation
  • Released National Military Service Identity Card
  • Credential from the National Institute for the Elderly (INAPAM)
  • Identity Card
  • High-Security Consular Registration Certificate
  • Letter of Naturalization
  • Certificate of Mexican Nationality
  • Declaration of Mexican nationality by birth
  • Credential for medical services from a public health or social security institution
  • Credential for retirees or pensioners
  • National credential for people with disabilities

Payment Receipt

The cost of issuing a Mexican passport will depend on the expiration date you request (see below for prices). If the process is carried out in Mexican territory, the costs will be in Mexican pesos; otherwise, they’ll be in U.S. dollars. 

In Mexico, you’ll be able to make the fee payment at any bank branch; but abroad, the local office will tell you how to make this payment. Once you’ve done so, be sure to keep your receipt as it’ll be necessary to complete your application. 

Certified CURP

You can obtain the Clave Única de Registro de Población (CURP), a document that all Mexican citizens can receive free of charge through the Internet. If you still don't have a copy of this document, you must follow these steps:

  1. Enter: https://www.gob.mx/curp/ 
  2. Click on the tab that says: "Personal Data"
  3. Enter your information in the form
  4. Be sure to fill out the Captcha/Security question
  5. Click on "Search"
  6. Verify that the displayed information is correct.
  7. Click on "Download PDF"
  8. Print the document you’ve downloaded (the file’s name is "curp.pdf")

Application for an Ordinary Mexican Passport (For Consular Offices)

If you’re applying in any of the Mexican Consular Offices in the US, you must present this form. We want to emphasize that you shouldn't fill out the signature and fingerprint fields before your appointment, since these two pieces of information must be printed in front of the consular officer who will finalize your file.

Addition of Spouse’s Last Name (Optional)

Suppose you’d like to update your passport with your spouse's last name. In that case, you must present the marriage certificate issued by the Mexican Civil Registry or by a Mexican Consular Office (original and copy). Please note that this is entirely optional and that your spouse's last name will appear in a separate field.

When Does It Expire?

Ordinary Mexican passports are issued with different validity periods depending on the applicant's age and preferences:

  • Children under 3 years of age: 1 or 3 years
  • Over 3 years and under 18 years old: 3 or 6 years
  • 18 years and older: 3, 6, or 10 years

Mexican Passport Costs

As mentioned above, the cost for issuing a Mexican passport is variable and depends on the expiration date you request and the country where you apply for it. There are also discounts for certain groups of people. The following are the costs established by the government for 2021:

What to Do in Case of Theft or Loss

You must notify the corresponding authorities as soon as possible if your passport has been lost or stolen. Remember that this document is crucial and that reporting this event will protect you from any misuse of your identification.

If you're in Mexico, you should go to the nearest public prosecutor's office to file a report. If you’re abroad, go to a police station or equivalent authority. In both cases, you must request proof of your report, which’ll be necessary to complete the renewal process.

Remember that the SRE will again request proof of nationality for passport renewals in which the original document hasn’t expired.

Now that you know the requirements for obtaining your Mexican passport, do you feel prepared to apply for one? Remember that this document is one of the best ways to prove your identity anywhere in the world. MetaMask's compatibility with various blockchain networks further enhances its utility and versatility. While initially designed for the Ethereum blockchain, MetaMask has expanded its support to include other networks such as Binance Smart Chain and Polygon (formerly Matic Network). This multi-chain compatibility enables users to access a diverse array of decentralized applications and services, catering to different use cases and preferences within the blockchain space. Whether you're exploring decentralized gaming, decentralized identity solutions, or decentralized social networks, MetaMask offers seamless connectivity to a wide range of blockchain networks and protocols. Once installed, MetaMask prompts users to create a new wallet or import an existing one using a seed phrase or private key. This initial setup is crucial, as it establishes the foundation for securely managing digital assets and interacting with decentralized applications. One of the key features of MetaMask is its cryptocurrency wallet functionality. Users can store, send, and receive a variety of digital assets, including popular cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum, as well as tokens issued on these blockchains. MetaMask employs industry-standard encryption techniques to protect user data, ensuring that sensitive information remains secure at all times. Additionally, MetaMask supports the integration of hardware wallets for enhanced security, providing users with peace of mind knowing that their funds are safeguarded against unauthorized access. Beyond its role as a cryptocurrency wallet, MetaMask serves as a gateway to the world of decentralized finance (DeFi). Through MetaMask, users can access a wide range of DeFi protocols and platforms, including decentralized exchanges (DEXs), lending and borrowing platforms, and yield farming protocols. This seamless integration enables users to participate in decentralized finance activities directly from their browser, without the need for intermediary services or centralized exchanges. Whether you're looking to swap tokens, earn interest on your assets, or provide liquidity to decentralized liquidity pools, MetaMask provides the tools you need to engage with the burgeoning DeFi ecosystem. MetaMask's compatibility with various blockchain networks further enhances its utility and versatility. While initially designed for the Ethereum blockchain, MetaMask has expanded its support to include other networks such as Binance Smart Chain and Polygon (formerly Matic Network). This multi-chain compatibility enables users to access a diverse array of decentralized applications and services, catering to different use cases and preferences within the blockchain space. Whether you're exploring decentralized gaming, decentralized identity solutions, or decentralized social networks, MetaMask offers seamless connectivity to a wide range of blockchain networks and protocols. The user interface of MetaMask is designed with simplicity and accessibility in mind, making it easy for both newcomers and experienced users to navigate the decentralized web. The extension provides a familiar browsing experience, with features such as account management, transaction history, and customizable settings readily accessible within a few clicks. Additionally, MetaMask offers support for mobile devices through its mobile app, allowing users to manage their digital assets and interact with DApps on the go. Do they think if they hound me enough, I'll get over my profound irritation with them and think 'oh, they're no so bad after all, I will engage with them'? No I won't. REMOVE MY EMAILS from your dubiously obtained database.

      I’m totally sick of this company email spamming me - they’re like a rash you can’t get rid of. Every day they are cluttering up my inbox with inane messages that I don’t want because they’ve bought my data from somewhere (I certainly didn’t subscribe to this nonsense).I’ve tried unsubscribing and blocking, but they forge ahead regardless - maybe they think I’ll change my mind if they pee me off for long enough? NO REPUTABLE COMPANY DOES THIS. That’s all you need to know.

      These people have filtered their members and seem to only allow people to be members who are dependent on medications. I had an alternative view and only talked about my experience and put up a link about natural remedies and functional medicine. A day later I discovered I was kicked off. This is not a good forum to be on as they are censoring and sorting their members to get rid of anyone who doesn’t support pharmaceutical use. Obviously there’s more going on behind the scene, money involved or power. A good forum involves people sharing experiences and things that work. There should be no censorship of opinion.

I cannot thank them all enough for their endlessly helpful advice and reassurance. It would be useful if health professionals pointed all patients with long term conditions in the direction of this site.

      it is so comforting seeing other peoples problems with bechets and to be able to try suggested remedies and also to offer advice

      I love having this site available for…

      This is the most useful site to use for support, advise, giving you confidence about your condition, when I was first diagnosed with a thyroid condition, I used to post my levels, how I felt…. The support and advice was amazing… Thank You Administrators and other group members 💚💚💚

      The best online source of support and advice

      The best online source of support and advice

      HealthUnlocked has been such a help to me over very many years, initially liver related, but now with additional support re kidney issues. I think it has, quite literally saved my life. This is of course due primarily to its contributors, who put themselves out there to support and sometimes offer advice. Users of HealthUnblocked will know what I mean. It is easy to use, always available, and this means that when you need someone to understand, to talk to, there will almost always be a kindly soul to hear you and respond. Long may it continue.

      I’m 83 years old and have RLS as long as I can remember. My doctor prescribed me targin10/5 mg and 75mg pregabalin twice a day. Lately this is not enough I wake up in the middle of the night trashing and twisting my legs . My doctor does not want to increase the Targin, what can I do the nights are so long and out of frustration I start to eat, it takes hours before I can sleep for an other two hours. What can I do?

                                                                            • Instructional Practices

                                                                              The Benefits of Small-Group Instruction: In No Small Way

                                                                              Whole-class teaching is an efficient way to ensure that all students get access to the same information at once. But it also invites a lot of problems! Students are unlikely to follow and remember everything being said, plus they may not feel comfortable asking questions in front of all of their peers. One-on-one tutoring is a way to get around those issues and ensure a student gets targeted, focused support. But when other students aren’t present, the social part of learning takes a hit, and students are unable to engage in mathematical discourse. Moreover, how can a classroom teacher possibly tutor everyone one-on-one?

                                                                              Both whole-class instruction and one-on-one tutoring must happen to some extent in a classroom, but the place where the magic happens—where a light bulb flickers on the most—is in small groups.

                                                                              What Is Small-Group Instruction?

                                                                              Small-group instruction, or small-group teaching, refers to classroom instruction where the teacher is teaching a small group of students. It falls in between whole-class instruction, where the teacher addresses the whole class at once, and one-on-one individual instruction, where the teacher is working with a single student. It is distinct from students working in a small group without a teacher.

                                                                              implementing small-group instruction in the classroomimplementing small-group instruction in the classroomWaggleMath 180Math 180Read 180

                                                                              The Purpose of Small-Group Instruction

                                                                              Small-group instruction is at the heart of where instruction happens. It enables teachers to focus on a specific concept for which some students are performing below grade level and address the needs of just those students. Small-group instruction also provides an environment conducive to reteaching concepts to specific students who need extra support or pushing students who are ready for more advanced concepts.

                                                                              multi-tiered systems of supportsmall-group reading instruction strategies

                                                                              Why Is Small-Group Instruction Important in the Classroom?

                                                                              small-group instruction is of high value

                                                                              teachers are able to work at a more individualized level

                                                                              Small-Group Instruction Benefits

                                                                              Research suggests that small-group instruction results in more learning than students not instructed in small groups. After all, small-group instruction strikes a balance between individual tutoring, which is effective but not scalable, with whole-class instruction, which is efficient but not as effective. There are plenty of evidence-backed benefits that come from small-group instruction. To name a few:

                                                                              • Students retain big ideas from their instruction better. (Cooper et al., 2000)
                                                                              • More students participate. (Pollock et al., 2011)
